title: Cube Root 3 Irrationality: Eisenstein Criterion Proof

problemStatement.formal: Prove Irrational ((3 : R) ^ (1 / 3 : R)) by showing X^3 - 3 is irreducible over Q via Eisenstein, hence has no rational root.
problemStatement.plain: Give an algebraic proof that the cube root of 3 is irrational: Eisenstein at p=3 proves X^3 - 3 irreducible over Q, irreducibility rules out rational roots, and a rational cube root would be such a root.
whyMatters: Demonstrates the stronger polynomial route from irreducibility to irrationality instead of only checking integer cube bounds.
Reuses the general Eisenstein infrastructure from CubeRoot2IrrationalOQ03.

proven: X3_sub_3_irred proves X^3 - 3 is irreducible over Q by Eisenstein at p=3.
X3_sub_3_no_rat_root proves X^3 - 3 has no rational roots by an irreducibility and degree argument.
cbrt3_irrational_via_eisenstein proves the cube root of 3 is irrational.
